component.name: HS80 Control
component.summary: Control Corsair HS80 RGB Wireless through its supported receiver
Corsair HS80 RGB Wireless über kompatiblen Empfänger steuern

description.p: HS80 Control manages RGB zones, battery information, sleep timeout, sidetone and microphone gain for the Corsair HS80 RGB Wireless through receiver USB ID 1b1c:0a6b.

Headset product ID 0a69 is hardware-tested. Product ID 0a71 is experimental. HS80 MAX, HS80 RGB USB/wired, Xbox or Bluetooth variants, receivers with other USB IDs and multiple simultaneous receivers are not supported.
It can also create a PipeWire 7.1 virtual sink and render it to stereo with a user-selected SOFA HRTF.
Redesigned as a native GNOME app: view switcher navigation, theme-aware cards and colors that follow the system style.
Explain muted-microphone lighting suppression and re-apply profiles on unmute.
Fix applying RGB profiles from the GTK interface on Fedora.
Fix hardware response matching and active headset discovery.
